heroes.author: EgorovaSvetlana
heroes.credit_line: Photo: EgorovaSvetlana, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Arecibo radio telescope dish at Arecibo Observatory, photographed in 2009 before its 2020 collapse.
heroes.why: Only landscape full-dish candidate over 1600 px; other Arecibo files are catwalk/deck/12 m dish shots; image not viewed.

No photograph of Big Ear on Commons: file searches return nothing relevant, Commons category Ohio State University Radio Observatory is empty, and the English Wikipedia article uses only the Wow signal printout, a map and an unrelated photo. Observatory was demolished 1998; bigear.org not fetched for licences.
